I was reading under my favourite tree, when the pages started to glow.
Then something rose out of the book. A door.
I didn't think twice. I jumped.
And I landed ten years in the future.
A helicopter came down on the lawn, and out stepped... me.
I did all I wanted to.
But how? The book pulled me back, page by page, to where it all began.
One ordinary night, I wrote my dream down.
Build my own company. It looked impossible.
The next morning, the alarm rang.
I could hit snooze, and sleep till ten,
or get up, and give my dream one hour.
So which one? I got up.
That night, my phone was calling.
And then I picked it again. And again. Every single day.
But not every choice was right. My first company failed.
It hurt. But it wasn't the end. It was a lesson.
So I adjusted, and chose again.
Day twelve hundred and four. My first big client.
Some split my path apart. Some brought it back together.
And all of them led to the same place.
Then I was back under the tree. Same book.
The first page was blank. So I wrote it down.
That's what Deem-yor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do.
